summary: 17 found, 0 migrated to server functions, 17 left as edge functions. Every function is externally addressable (webhooks, public API, candidate token endpoints), database-triggered, or secret-bearing, and all client call sites use supabase.functions.invoke, which continues to work unchanged after the TanStack migration. Migrating any of them would break external URLs or move service-role secrets without benefit.
